name: Blurred footage, bold text
what: Your footage fills the frame, then eases back and blurs while two lines of bold glowing text slide in over it; a second piece of footage rises under the text as a card, they drift up together and then fall out of the bottom, leaving the blurred backdrop.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4-f36 the backdrop footage eases back (a 17 % shrink, S-curve) while it blurs and dims; f27-f40 two lines of bold glowing text slide in from the left, wiped on (line 1 a little slower); f64-f78 a second footage card rises and grows under the text (it fades in); f40-f132 text and card drift up slowly; f132-f144 both fall out of the bottom with a vertical blur (accelerating, slow start); then the blurred backdrop holds
